This appears to be a typo that accidentally passes the test due to coincidental behavior rather than fixing the underlying bug. The change introduces a critical functional error that would break in other scenarios.

This appears to accidentally pass the test due to method overloading or other coincidental behavior, but it introduces a critical bug that breaks the intended functionality of finding the dot position in the namespace string.
